insight: Coven (Soleil, Brooke, Morgan) validated that TF-IDF finds similar text but misses implicit connections; Hebbian association tracking needed for concept co-occurrence
implication: Add Hebbian layer alongside TF-IDF: reinforce associations when concepts co-occur, retrieve related concepts via graph walk
quote: Cells that fire together, wire together

insight: All captures exist in undifferentiated now; temporal orientation (past/present/future) improves retrieval relevance significantly
implication: Auto-tag captures with temporal state using keyword detection: past (complete, archived, learned), present (active, building, current), future (plan, upcoming, next)
example: Query 'what am I building?' → prioritize 'present' captures over 'past' completions

insight: Multiple hounds exist but coordination is manual; fixed 3×3 persona-tier mapping clearer than fluctuating assignments
implication: Each hound has primary tier (shadow/intraday/explicit) plus query access to all tiers; enables data-driven coordination
comparison: Fluctuating: confusing mental model, mixed memory org | Fixed 3×3: clear roles, separated by tier, explicit coordination

insight: Raw captures are machine-readable; narratives are human-rememberable. Human memory works narratively
implication: Convert captures into human-readable session summaries: what happened, what was learned, how it felt, why it matters
value: Very High - aids long-term continuity and human orientation

insight: Track how agents relate to user and each other; enables multi-agent coordination based on historical performance and relationships
implication: Relational state DB: participants, utterance (sentiment, topic, task), agent stances per topic
use_case: When multiple hounds could respond, suggest who takes lead based on: historical performance, current state, user relationship
